caption: The drawing depicts a single, gold-colored candlestick set against a plain, off-white background. The candlestick has a broad, square base with slightly flared edges supporting a tiered, rounded pedestal that transitions into a slender, elongated shaft. The shaft is slightly fluted and features a small, horizontal band with a textured surface about midway up. The upper portion broadens gradually into a wide, flat, and slightly concave lip where a candle would be placed. The composition is centered and the candlestick is rendered with fine shading and highlights, suggesting a metallic, reflective surface. There are no other objects or elements present in the image, and a narrow border frames the entire scene. A faint scale line and some small inscription appear at the bottom.
title: Candlestick
